imageFormulaCheck.observedMessage: Please use a desktop web browser to allow access to fetch data from external urls.
imageFormulaCheck.interpretation: The committed IMAGE formulas are present and correct, but native Google Sheets has not yet been granted external-URL fetch permission for this new test workbook.
imageFormulaCheck.requiredNextCheck: Open the dedicated test workbook in a desktop browser, allow external URL access when prompted, then re-read image cells and require successful rendering before accepting the test-Sheet gate.

conclusion: Do not promote or write to the production inventory Sheet until the image-permission check passes.
